name: goxide
description: Goxide language services through the goxide compiler.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Goxide starts the configured compiler and prepares project dependencies.

commands.title: Goxide: Enable Managed Go for This Project

input.description: Project directory, manifest, or one .gox file. Empty uses the current Goxide project.

lib.description: Select the library when debugging tests.

target.description: Compilation target; debugging requires the host platform.

cwd.description: Working directory of the debugged program.

env.description: Environment overrides for the debugged program.

package.description: Selected test package from Goxide test discovery.

dlv.description: Original Delve executable; defaults to goxide.dlv.

goxide.enabled.description: Enable Goxide language services in this folder.

goxide.executable.description: Goxide executable path or command on PATH. Relative paths resolve from the workspace folder.

goxide.gopls.description: Original gopls executable path, command on PATH, or off to disable Go-backed services.

goxide.dlv.description: Original Delve executable used for Goxide debugging. Relative paths resolve from the workspace folder.

goxide.input.description: Project directory, goxide.toml, or one .gox file, relative to the workspace folder. Empty discovers goxide.toml; other .gox files use standalone sessions.

goxide.bin.description: Selected project binary. Mutually exclusive with goxide.example and goxide.lib.

goxide.example.description: Selected project example. Mutually exclusive with goxide.bin and goxide.lib.

goxide.lib.description: Select the project library. Mutually exclusive with goxide.bin and goxide.example.

goxide.features.description: Selected Goxide features. Changing this restarts the project session.

goxide.target.description: Selected GOOS/GOARCH target, such as linux/amd64. Empty uses the compiler default.

goxide.enableManagedGo.description: Let Goxide serve .go files in explicitly managed projects. Disable the Go extension for this workspace first to avoid a second gopls session.

scripts.check: node --check extension.js && node --check config.js && node --check development.js
